 Gemini deprecations

This page lists the known deprecation schedules for stable (GA) and preview models and for managed agents in the Gemini API. A " deprecation" is the announcement that we no longer provide support for a model, and that it will be " shut down" in the near future. Once a model is " shutdown", it is completely turned off, and the endpoint is no longer available.

Deprecation announcements are made on the Release notes page, and the announced earliest shutdown dates are tracked on this page. Already-shutdown models are indicated with gray backgrounds.

Note: The shutdown dates listed in the table indicate the earliest possible dates on which a model might be retired. We will communicate the exact shutdown date to users with advance notice to ensure a smooth transition to a replacement model.

What's new in Gemini 3.7 Flash | Gemini API | Google AI for Developers

 What's new in Gemini 3.7 Flash

Caution: Deprecated: Gemini 3.7 Flash (`gemini-3.7-flash`) is deprecated and has been replaced by Gemini 3.8 Flash (`gemini-3.8-flash`). It is no longer available to select in Google AI Studio, and API requests to `gemini-3.7-flash` are automatically routed to `gemini-3.8-flash`. Update your model string to `gemini-3.8-flash` and review the Gemini 3.8 Flash guide.

Gemini 3.7 Flash (`gemini-3.7-flash`) is a previous-generation Flash model in the Gemini 3 series, now deprecated and automatically routed to Gemini 3.8 Flash.

This guide is preserved for reference and documents the capabilities and changes introduced in Gemini 3.7 Flash.

## Model overview

| Model | Model ID | Default thinking level | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Gemini 3.7 Flash (Deprecated) | `gemini-3.7-flash` | `medium` | Previous-generation Flash model built for coding, agentic workflows, and multi-step execution. Replaced by Gemini 3.8 Flash. |

Gemini 3.7 Flash supports a 1M token context window, 64k max output tokens, tunable thinking levels (`low`, `medium`, `high`), and the same suite of built-in tools as 3.6 Flash.

For complete specs, see the Gemini 3.7 Flash model page.

### Python

```
from google import genai

client = genai.Client()

interaction = client.interactions.create(
    model="gemini-3.7-flash",
    input="Write a responsive navigation component in React with smooth animations and dark mode toggle."
)

print(interaction.output_text)

```

### JavaScript

```
import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai";

const client = new GoogleGenAI({});

const interaction = await client.interactions.create({
  model: "gemini-3.7-flash",
  input: "Write a responsive navigation component in React with smooth animations and dark mode toggle.",
});

console.log(interaction.output_text);

```

### Java

```
import com.google.genai.Client;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.CreateModelInteraction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Interaction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.InteractionsInput;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Model;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.operations.CreateInteractionRequestBody;

Client client = new Client();
CreateModelInteraction req = CreateModelInteraction.builder()
    .model(Model.of("gemini-3.7-flash"))
    .input(InteractionsInput.of("Write a responsive navigation component in React with smooth animations and dark mode toggle."))
    .build();
Interaction interaction =
    client.interactions.create(CreateInteractionRequestBody.of(req)).interaction().get();
System.out.println(interaction.outputText().orElse(""));

```

### REST

```
curl "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions" \
  -H "x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -X POST \
  -d '{
    "model": "gemini-3.7-flash",
    "input": "Write a responsive navigation component in React with smooth animations and dark mode toggle."
  }'

```

## What's new in Gemini 3.7 Flash

- Coding and agentic tasks: Significantly higher quality on real-world software engineering and agentic benchmarks, improving issue resolution and reducing failed agent loops.
- Web development and stronger design parity: Generates higher-fidelity desktop and web application code directly from design mocks, with strong gains in design adherence and in auditing existing codebases against mocks to verify 1:1 design parity.

## Understanding reasoning levels

Gemini 3.7 Flash gives developers flexible control over latency and intelligence by adjusting the model's thinking level:

- Low thinking effort: Reduces time-to-answer for latency-critical tasks like incident response pipelines, real-time chat, writing drafts, and fast data analysis.
- Medium (default): Best quality for most tasks. Recommended for complex code and agentic use cases, with higher first-pass accur

# Gemini 3.7 Flash deprecation

By Steven Van · 2026-10-08

Requests now route to Gemini 3.8 Flash automatically, while an older Deep Research agent will shut down on October 23, 2026.

API requests to the deprecated gemini-3.7-flash model in Google Gemini are now automatically routed to gemini-3.8-flash. The announcement also covers migration from Gemini 3.5 Flash and an older Deep Research agent.

## Flash model migration

Developers using gemini-3.7-flash should update their model string to gemini-3.8-flash and review the Gemini 3.8 Flash guide.

Gemini 3.5 Flash is also deprecated, with requests to gemini-3.5-flash automatically routed to gemini-3.6-flash. Developers should change that model string to gemini-3.6-flash or gemini-3.8-flash and review the Gemini 3.6 Flash guide.

## Deep Research agent shutdown

The deep-research-pro-preview-12-2025 agent is deprecated and will shut down on October 23, 2026. Developers must update the agent parameter in their interactions.create requests to one of two newer versions:

- deep-research-preview-04-2026, designed for speed and efficiency and suited to streaming responses back to a client UI.
- deep-research-max-preview-04-2026, designed for maximum comprehensiveness in automated context gathering and synthesis.

results.text:
Gemini 3.7 Flash and 3.5 Flash deprecated in the API | Adaptd

# Google is swapping older Gemini Flash models for newer ones automatically, like a mechanic who upgrades your parts without ringing first

By Brett Gavaghan, Founder of Adaptd · 13 October 2026

On 8 October Google deprecated Gemini 3.7 Flash and 3.5 Flash in its API and started sending their requests to newer models. An older Deep Research agent shuts down on 23 October.

The short version

- Google deprecated Gemini 3.7 Flash and Gemini 3.5 Flash in the Gemini API on 8 October 2026.
- Calls to those models now go to Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.6 Flash automatically, and an older Deep Research agent shuts down on 23 October.
- If a tool your business uses was built on the Gemini API, ask the developer to test it on the newer model.

If someone built your business a quoting tool or an email sorter on Gemini, it may have had a brain transplant on 8 October. Nobody sent a card.

## What changed in the Gemini API?

Google's Gemini API changelog says Gemini 3.7 Flash is deprecated and replaced by Gemini 3.8 Flash, and Gemini 3.5 Flash is replaced by Gemini 3.6 Flash. Requests that still use the old model names are routed to the newer models automatically.

Google also deprecated its deep-research-pro-preview-12-2025 agent, which shuts down on 23 October 2026. Developers can move to a faster preview version or a 'max' version built for more thorough research.

## Who does this affect?

The change affects businesses whose tools or automations call the Gemini API directly, usually something a developer or agency built for them. The routing happens in the API, so nothing breaks overnight.

The catch is that a newer model can word things differently, lay out answers differently or follow your instructions a little differently, and the tool won't mention that anything changed. Technically correct, slightly unfamiliar.

## What should your business do about it?

Businesses with a Gemini-powered tool should ask whoever built it which model it calls, then test it on the newer one and update the model name.

My advice: keep a small set of real examples, such as ten enquiries and the replies you were happy with, and re-run them whenever the model changes. If anything relies on the old Deep Research agent, move it before 23 October or it simply stops. Automatic routing is better than an error message, but software, eh? Even the parts you never see get a service you didn't book.

# Gemini 3.7 Flash Deprecation: Migrating to Gemini 3.8 Flash

Understand the 2026-10-08 Gemini API deprecations, automatic routing changes, thinking level updates, and migration steps for Deep Research agents.

By ailog · Published Oct 11, 2026 · 5 min read · How we work

In short

- Gemini 3.7 Flash and Gemini 3.5 Flash are deprecated, with calls automatically routed to Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.6 Flash.
- The Deep Research agent deep-research-pro-preview-12-2025 faces shutdown on October 23, 2026.
- Introductory rates of $0.75 per 1M input tokens and $3.75 per 1M output tokens apply to Gemini 3.8 Flash through December 31, 2026.
- The minimal thinking level is unsupported on Gemini 3.8 Flash and will trigger errors if not updated to low, medium, or high.
- Deprecated sampling settings including temperature, top_p, and top_k must be removed across Gemini 3 calls.

## API Changes Announced on 2026-10-08

The Gemini developer platform received a series of model retirements and routing updates announced on 2026-10-08 in the Gemini API changelog. The update deprecates `gemini-3.7-flash` alongside `gemini-3.5-flash` while establishing a retirement date for the initial preview generation of the managed Deep Research agent.

For standard text and multimodal requests, the backend provides automatic server-side forwarding. Queries directed to `gemini-3.7-flash` route directly to `gemini-3.8-flash`. Concurrently, requests specifying `gemini-3.5-flash` route to `gemini-3.6-flash`. While existing workloads will not fail immediately due to these routing rules, explicit model migration is necessary to align parameter configurations, adjust billing expectations, and avoid configuration errors.

- Gemini 3.7 Flash (`gemini-3.7-flash`) is deprecated and automatically routed to Gemini 3.8 Flash (`gemini-3.8-flash`).
- Gemini 3.5 Flash (`gemini-3.5-flash`) is deprecated and automatically routed to Gemini 3.6 Flash (`gemini-3.6-flash`).
- The managed agent `deep-research-pro-preview-12-2025` is deprecated with a final shutdown date of October 23, 2026.
- Default agent execution for the Antigravity agent now targets Gemini 3.8 Flash by default.

## Gemini 3.8 Flash Capabilities, Pricing, and Token Dynamics

The release of `gemini-3.8-flash` represents the general availability target for developer workloads requiring rapid reasoning, autonomous tool execution, and long-horizon software engineering. The model features a 1M token context window and accommodates up to 64k max output tokens. It is engineered to perform iterative tool calls, execute multi-file code modifications, and reduce failed agent loops.

Developers monitoring operational costs should note the pricing schedule. An introductory rate is available through December 31, 2026, setting costs at $0.75 per 1M input tokens and $3.75 per 1M output tokens. Standard pricing takes effect January 1, 2027, increasing rates to $1.50 per 1M input tokens and $7.50 per 1M output tokens. For cost estimation across model tiers, teams can refer to /tools/llm-api-cost-calculator/.

Model Cards are intended to provide essential information on Gemini models, including known limitations, mitigation approaches, and safety performance. Model cards may be updated from time to time; for example, to include updated evaluations as the model is improved or revised. See the Google DeepMind site for a comprehensive list of model cards.

### Description

Gemini 3.8 Flash is the next iteration in the Gemini 3 model family, building on Gemini 3.7 Flash, delivering performance advancements across software engineering and agentic knowledge workflows. It continues to support customizable effort levels to control the mix of quality, cost and latency.

### Model dependencies

Text strings (e.g., a question, a prompt, document(s) to be summarized), images, audio, and video files, with a token context window of up to 1M.

Gemini API deprecates 3.7 and 3.5 Flash, automatically routing requests to replacements | SessionWatcher

# Gemini API deprecates 3.7 and 3.5 Flash, automatically routing requests to replacements

Google's October 8, 2026 release notes deprecate Gemini 3.7 Flash and 3.5 Flash. Neither remains selectable in Google AI Studio; API requests automatically route to Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.6 Flash respectively.

SessionWatcher editorial · Published 2026-10-11 · Updated 2026-10-13 · Source announcement: 2026-10-08

## Deprecated models leave AI Studio selection

Google's October 8, 2026 Gemini API release notes say Gemini 3.7 Flash and Gemini 3.5 Flash are deprecated. Both are no longer available to select in Google AI Studio.

Gemini 3.7 Flash has been replaced by Gemini 3.8 Flash. Gemini 3.5 Flash has been replaced by Gemini 3.6 Flash.

## API requests route to replacements

API requests to gemini-3.7-flash automatically route to gemini-3.8-flash, while requests to gemini-3.5-flash automatically route to gemini-3.6-flash.

Google recommends updating the 3.7 model string to gemini-3.8-flash. For the 3.5 model string, it recommends gemini-3.6-flash or gemini-3.8-flash, and reviewing the linked replacement-model guides.
